verdict.rationale: Penpot ships a first-party MCP server that lets any LLM/AI agent connect and 'prompt away' to read and manipulate design files, since designs are expressed as code for easy AI interaction; a runtime probe confirms the self-hosted MCP service completing a real JSON-RPC handshake with tool capabilities exposed to agents. This directly enables natural-language operation of the product via a connected agent. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports of actually issuing natural-language commands and seeing correct design edits, and detail on the breadth/reliability of exposed tools.
